bilibili-video-extractor v1.0.0

- Initial release.
- Extracts key data from Bilibili videos (views, likes, favorites, danmu, etc.).
- Analyzes danmu sentiment and translates user reactions into actionable insights.
- Provides clear explanations for why videos become popular, with practical title formulas and content inspiration.
- Designed for Bilibili content operators, planners, and anyone interested in viral video strategies.
- Requires following detailed workflow and terminology guidelines as defined in core_workflow.md.
